verdict.rationale: Weave provides a flexible imperative Evaluation API and Service API (REST) that could in principle be scripted into a CI pipeline to catch regressions (docs-6, docs-19, docs-31, docs-38, docs-15), but there is no documented CI/CD integration (e.g., GitHub Actions template, CLI exit codes, threshold-based pass/fail gating) for automatically blocking deployments on eval results. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs, deployment-gating mechanism (exit codes/thresholds), example CI workflow config.
